title: Industrial SIEM & OT SOC Pakistan 2026 — Security Event Monitoring for PLC, HMI & SCADA with CERT-PK & NCA Compliance
summary_html: Complete buyer guide to Industrial SIEM and OT Security Operations Centre (OT SOC) deployment in Pakistan 2026. Covers OT SIEM platforms (Claroty, Dragos, Nozomi, Fortinet FortiSIEM, Microsoft Sentinel + Defender for IoT, Wazuh open-source), PKR pricing for all tiers, CERT-PK 24-hour incident reporting workflow, NCA ECC compliance controls, IEC 62443 zone integration, and OT SOC staffing models for Pakistani textile, pharmaceutical, and power-utility operators.
